sanskrit_verse:
यस् तु संस्क्रियते न्यासो दिवसैः परिनिष्ठितैः ।
तद् ऊर्ध्व स्थापयञ् शिल्पी दाप्यो दैवहतोऽपि तत् ॥
transliteration: yas tu saṃskriyate nyāso divasaiḥ pariniṣṭhitaiḥ | tad ūrdhva sthāpayañ śilpī dāpyo daivahato 'pi tat ||
sph_interpretive_translation: He who deposits an item for transformation or completion within a fixed number of days, the artisan shall deliver it upward, even if destroyed by divine forces.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from depositor to artisan upon acceptance
Causation is attributed to divine intervention without nullifying contractual duty
Capacity-based responsibility demands fulfillment regardless of external disruption
Restoration logic requires reconstruction or equivalent restitution
Consciousness alignment necessitates honoring intent over outcome
executable_legal_axioms: IF item deposited WITH specified time-frame THEN artisan assumes delivery obligation
IF item destroyed BY divine cause THEN artisan must restore OR compensate equivalently
IF artisan accepts task THEN capacity is presumed AND execution is binding
IF failure occurs WITHOUT willful neglect THEN restoration replaces penalty
IF intent was preserved THEN outcome distortion does NOT void agreement
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudicates based on capacity acknowledgment and intent preservation; divine causation does not absolve performance duty but redirects enforcement toward reconstruction rather than compensation for fault.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that acceptance creates causality linkage; anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential duty fulfillment; proportional responsibility lies in restoration, not punitive damages; reality remains non-punitive as consciousness upholds original commitment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Reconstruct item per original specifications
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Artisan affirms continuity of duty despite loss
Capacity Restoration: Provide resources or time extension for faithful recreation
Integrity Reintegration: Public acknowledgment of completed restoration to uphold trust
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is executed through conscious restoration, not punitive reaction. The artisan fulfills duty through integrity-renewing action, aligning with Nyaya and SPH's non-punitive cosmic order.
